outcome: Adherence rate to universal GBS screening policy
cohort: The study participants were mothers and their neonates whose delivery records were examined from Hong Kong Baptist Hospital in 2022, specifically focusing on term neonates from GBS carriers.
finding: Antenatal antibiotic treatment before Caesarean section or intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis given for 4 or more hours before vaginal delivery significantly decreased the risk of neonatal sepsis in term neonates from GBS carriers.
mod_finding: For term neonates from GBS carriers, antenatal antibiotic treatment before Caesarean section reduced the risk of neonatal sepsis by 70%, while intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis given for 4 or more hours before vaginal delivery reduced the risk by 71%.
